inlines.v: ALP, ALPS noun [Gr. white; Latin albus A high mountain. The name, it is supposed, was originally given to mountains whose tops were covered with snow, and hence appropriately applied to the mountains of Swisserland; so that by alps is generally understood the latter mountains. But geographers apply the name to any high mountains.
